data.description: At 4th level, you may use a breath weapon %1 times per day as a standard action. When you gain this ability, choose acid, cold, fire, or electricity-this determines what kind of damage your breath weapon deals. Once you make this choice, you cannot change it later. Your breath weapon fills a is-foot cone, and deals %2d6 points of damage. A creature hit by your dragonbreath attack can attempt a Reflex save (DC %3) to take half damage.|1+(DomainScalykindLVL>=9)+(DomainScalykindLVL>=14)|1+DomainScalykindLVL/2|DomainScalykindDC
